source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create a pixel-verifiable, complex reference-guided photograph in which a scheduled orbital-station inspection makes microgravity legible through unsupported bodies, divergent object orientations, and active handrail control.
subject: An original visibly adult station specialist, using the attached portrait only as visible face-and-hair appearance reference and never as identity evidence.
setting: A crowded operational orbital-station module lined with equipment racks, handrails, cables, and secured stowage during a scheduled inspection.
event: The specialist floats diagonally with both feet clear of every surface, hooks fingertips around a handrail to arrest motion, and passes among multiple unsupported loose objects pointing in different directions.
visual_priorities: Make the indoor microgravity state unmistakable through simultaneous unsupported floating, divergent orientations, and handrail-based motion control.
Keep the original adult subject's referenced visible facial structure, eye appearance, lower-face shape, hairline, and long dark wavy hair readable in the same wide frame.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a landscape visible-light operational documentary photograph inside a crowded orbital-station module during a scheduled inspection. Microgravity is made visible through simultaneous unsupported floating, divergent orientations, and handrail-based motion control. An original visibly adult station specialist floats diagonally with both feet visibly clear of every surface while hooked fingertips arrest motion on a handrail. The specialist's readable face shape, eye appearance, lower-face shape, hairline, and long dark wavy hair follow the attached portrait as appearance-only reference. At least three loose objects float unsupported at clearly different orientations; one soft equipment pouch appears upside down relative to the specialist. Dense station racks, handrails, cables, labeled equipment panels, and secured stowage establish a functional orbital interior. The wide composition presents several competing orientations rather than one organizing down direction, while crisp practical cabin light keeps the face, free-floating body, loose objects, and controlling hand contact simultaneously legible.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: Treat the randomly assigned microgravity concept as pixel-verifiable visual semantics whose defining components must survive the prompt and rendered image.
